name: agent-workspace
description: Mirrors the container's /workspace into ~/.agent-workspaces/<project>-<date>-<RUN_ID> on the host, so you can watch and open the agent's checkout in a local editor. Supplies the storage only — a workspace plugin still fills it. Security: the agent writes everything in the mirror, including .vscode/ tasks, settings and launch configs; never grant it workspace trust in VS Code (or run git hooks there) on the host.

settings.label: Mirror directory
settings.description: Host directory holding the per-run mirrors, <dir>/<project>-<date>-<RUN_ID>.

settings.label: Delete the mirror on exit
settings.description: Off keeps it for inspection, one leftover directory per run.
